# doctui

Generated component and package reference for doctui 0.0.0.

## Packages

- @doctui/core: Core Vue components, theme and primitives.
- @doctui/hooks: Reusable Vue composables for browser and app state.
- @doctui/form: Vue-first form state, validation and submit helpers.
- @doctui/notifications: Notification store and accessible renderer.
- @doctui/dates: Dependency-free date and calendar components.
- @doctui/mcp-server: Local MCP server for querying the generated registry.

## Components

- ActionIcon (@doctui/core): Compact icon-only native button with an accessible name.
- Autocomplete (@doctui/core): Searchable single-value selection control backed by the shared Combobox engine.
- Badge (@doctui/core): Compact status label using semantic color and variant tokens.
- Box (@doctui/core): Low-level polymorphic container with token-based spacing.
- Button (@doctui/core): Native button control with doctui color, variant and size tokens.
- Calendar (@doctui/dates): Month calendar that emits ISO date selections.
- Center (@doctui/core): Flex helper that centers content on both axes.
- Checkbox (@doctui/core): Native checkbox semantics with doctui-controlled visual geometry and shared field messaging.
- Code (@doctui/core): Monospace inline or block code presentation.
- Combobox (@doctui/core): Focus-managed listbox engine used by doctui selection controls.
- Container (@doctui/core): Centered responsive container constrained by theme breakpoints.
- DateInput (@doctui/dates): Native date input with doctui field labeling and clear behavior.
- DatePicker (@doctui/dates): Date input with an optional calendar selection panel.
- DateTimePicker (@doctui/dates): Native date-time input with Vue v-model support.
- Divider (@doctui/core): Separator for related content with optional label content.
- Drawer (@doctui/core): Accessible side dialog with shared overlay, nested-layer dismissal and focus restoration.
- Flex (@doctui/core): Flexbox layout primitive with theme-token gaps.
- Grid (@doctui/core): CSS grid layout primitive with token-backed gaps and columns.
- Group (@doctui/core): Horizontal wrapping layout for related controls and content.
- InputWrapper (@doctui/core): Shared label, description, required and error structure for inputs.
- Kbd (@doctui/core): Semantic keyboard shortcut label.
- Loader (@doctui/core): Animated progress indicator for an indeterminate operation.
- Menu (@doctui/core): Keyboard-navigable menu built from native menu item buttons.
- Modal (@doctui/core): Accessible modal dialog with nested-layer dismissal, reference-counted scroll lock and focus restoration.
- MonthPicker (@doctui/dates): Month selection control that emits YYYY-MM values.
- MultiSelect (@doctui/core): Searchable multi-value selection control backed by the shared Combobox engine.
- Notifications (@doctui/notifications): Accessible renderer for notifications managed by a store.
- NumberInput (@doctui/core): Native numeric input with numeric v-model values and range constraints.
- Overlay (@doctui/core): Portal-backed semantic-color backdrop with controlled visibility and dismissal.
- Paper (@doctui/core): Surface container with optional border, radius and shadow.
- PasswordInput (@doctui/core): Password field built on the shared TextInput contract.
- Popover (@doctui/core): Dismissable contextual panel anchored to a target slot.
- Radio (@doctui/core): Native radio option with doctui-controlled visual geometry for a shared scalar v-model.
- SegmentedControl (@doctui/core): Single-selection control with radio semantics and arrow navigation.
- Select (@doctui/core): Single-value selection control backed by the shared Combobox focus model.
- Skeleton (@doctui/core): Loading placeholder that can reveal its content when ready.
- Space (@doctui/core): Semantic layout spacer using the theme spacing scale.
- Stack (@doctui/core): Vertical flex layout for consistent spacing between children.
- Switch (@doctui/core): Boolean toggle that keeps native checkbox behavior behind a doctui track and thumb visual.
- TagsInput (@doctui/core): Free-form token field with deterministic parsing, native focus and accessible token-list semantics.
- Text (@doctui/core): Semantic text primitive using doctui typography and color tokens.
- Textarea (@doctui/core): Multi-line text field with shared input wrapper semantics.
- TextInput (@doctui/core): Single-line text field with shared input wrapper semantics.
- Title (@doctui/core): Semantic h1-h6 heading primitive.
- Tooltip (@doctui/core): Non-essential contextual text revealed on hover or focus.
- UnstyledButton (@doctui/core): Native button reset for building custom action surfaces.
- YearPicker (@doctui/dates): Year selection control over a configurable range.

## API details

### ActionIcon

Package: `@doctui/core`

Compact icon-only native button with an accessible name.

Props: `ariaLabel`, `color`, `variant`, `size`, `radius`, `disabled`, `type`.

Accessibility: Requires ariaLabel because icon-only controls need an accessible name.

### Autocomplete

Package: `@doctui/core`

Searchable single-value selection control backed by the shared Combobox engine.

Props: `modelValue`, `data`, `id`, `label`, `description`, `error`, `required`, `disabled`, `placeholder`, `clearable`, `ariaLabel`, `nothingFound`, `size`, `radius`.

Accessibility: Filtering preserves a valid active descendant by option value and falls back to the first enabled visible option when needed.
Accessibility: Empty results remove aria-activedescendant and announce the nothingFound content as status text.
Accessibility: Clear is forwarded consistently with Select and MultiSelect.
Example: <Autocomplete id="framework-search" v-model="framework" :data="frameworks" label="Framework" nothing-found="No matches" />

### Badge

Package: `@doctui/core`

Compact status label using semantic color and variant tokens.

Props: `color`, `variant`, `size`, `radius`.


### Box

Package: `@doctui/core`

Low-level polymorphic container with token-based spacing.

Props: `as`, `padding`, `margin`.


### Button

Package: `@doctui/core`

Native button control with doctui color, variant and size tokens.

Props: `color`, `variant`, `size`, `radius`, `loading`, `disabled`, `fullWidth`, `type`.

Accessibility: Uses a native button element.
Accessibility: Loading state disables interaction and exposes aria-busy.
Accessibility: Focus-visible styles use the theme focus ring token.

### Calendar

Package: `@doctui/dates`

Month calendar that emits ISO date selections.

Props: `modelValue`, `month`, `minDate`, `maxDate`, `locale`, `firstDayOfWeek`.

Accessibility: Uses labeled native buttons and exposes selected dates with aria-pressed.

### Center

Package: `@doctui/core`

Flex helper that centers content on both axes.

Props: `as`, `inline`.


### Checkbox

Package: `@doctui/core`

Native checkbox semantics with doctui-controlled visual geometry and shared field messaging.

Props: `modelValue`, `id`, `label`, `description`, `error`, `required`, `disabled`, `size`, `classNames`, `styles`.

Accessibility: Keeps a native checkbox as the semantic, focus and keyboard source while rendering a custom visual indicator.
Accessibility: Disabled and required behavior uses native form semantics.
Example: <Checkbox v-model="accepted" label="Accept terms" size="lg" required />

### Code

Package: `@doctui/core`

Monospace inline or block code presentation.

Props: `block`, `size`.


### Combobox

Package: `@doctui/core`

Focus-managed listbox engine used by doctui selection controls.

Props: `modelValue`, `data`, `id`, `multiple`, `searchable`, `clearable`, `label`, `description`, `error`, `required`, `disabled`, `placeholder`, `ariaLabel`, `nothingFound`, `size`, `radius`.

Accessibility: Keeps DOM focus on the native combobox input and exposes the active enabled option through aria-activedescendant.
Accessibility: Arrow keys, Home and End skip disabled options; filtering never leaves aria-activedescendant pointing at a missing option.
Accessibility: Visible labels use the shared field relationship; ariaLabel is supported when no visible label is rendered, with a safe fallback accessible name.
Example: <Combobox id="framework" v-model="framework" :data="frameworks" label="Framework" clearable />
Example: <Combobox v-model="framework" :data="frameworks" searchable aria-label="Search framework" nothing-found="No matches" />

### Container

Package: `@doctui/core`

Centered responsive container constrained by theme breakpoints.

Props: `as`, `size`.


### DateInput

Package: `@doctui/dates`

Native date input with doctui field labeling and clear behavior.

Props: `modelValue`, `label`, `error`, `minDate`, `maxDate`, `disabled`, `clearable`.

Accessibility: Uses a native date input associated with its visible label.

### DatePicker

Package: `@doctui/dates`

Date input with an optional calendar selection panel.

Props: `modelValue`, `label`, `minDate`, `maxDate`, `clearable`.

Accessibility: The calendar toggle exposes expanded state and calendar buttons are keyboard accessible.

### DateTimePicker

Package: `@doctui/dates`

Native date-time input with Vue v-model support.

Props: `modelValue`, `label`, `disabled`.


### Divider

Package: `@doctui/core`

Separator for related content with optional label content.

Props: `orientation`, `size`, `color`, `label`.

Accessibility: Uses role=separator and exposes its orientation.

### Drawer

Package: `@doctui/core`

Accessible side dialog with shared overlay, nested-layer dismissal and focus restoration.

Props: `modelValue`, `title`, `ariaLabel`, `position`, `size`, `radius`, `closeOnEscape`, `closeOnClickOutside`, `withCloseButton`.

Accessibility: Uses role=dialog and aria-modal, traps focus, closes on Escape when enabled and restores the trigger on close.
Accessibility: A visible title provides aria-labelledby; ariaLabel names titleless drawers, with Drawer as a safety fallback.
Accessibility: Shared scroll locking is reference-counted so closing one nested layer never unlocks the page under another open layer.
Example: <Drawer v-model="open" title="Filters" position="right" size="md">...</Drawer>

### Flex

Package: `@doctui/core`

Flexbox layout primitive with theme-token gaps.

Props: `as`, `gap`, `direction`, `align`, `justify`, `wrap`.


### Grid

Package: `@doctui/core`

CSS grid layout primitive with token-backed gaps and columns.

Props: `as`, `columns`, `gap`, `align`, `justify`.


### Group

Package: `@doctui/core`

Horizontal wrapping layout for related controls and content.

Props: `as`, `gap`, `align`, `justify`, `wrap`.


### InputWrapper

Package: `@doctui/core`

Shared label, description, required and error structure for inputs.

Props: `id`, `label`, `description`, `error`, `required`, `classNames`, `styles`.

Accessibility: Generates an SSR-safe control ID when one is not provided and associates the visible label with that ID.
Accessibility: Keeps description and error messages in the DOM together and exposes both IDs to the scoped control slot.
Example: <InputWrapper label="Email"><template #default="{ id, describedBy }"><input :id="id" :aria-describedby="describedBy" /></template></InputWrapper>

### Kbd

Package: `@doctui/core`

Semantic keyboard shortcut label.

Props: `size`.


### Loader

Package: `@doctui/core`

Animated progress indicator for an indeterminate operation.

Props: `type`, `size`, `color`.

Accessibility: Uses role=status and provides a Loading accessible name.

### Menu

Package: `@doctui/core`

Keyboard-navigable menu built from native menu item buttons.

Props: `modelValue`, `data`, `closeOnClickOutside`.

Accessibility: Uses menu/menuitem roles and supports Arrow, Home, End and Escape.

### Modal

Package: `@doctui/core`

Accessible modal dialog with nested-layer dismissal, reference-counted scroll lock and focus restoration.

Props: `modelValue`, `title`, `ariaLabel`, `size`, `radius`, `centered`, `closeOnEscape`, `closeOnClickOutside`, `withCloseButton`.

Accessibility: Uses role=dialog and aria-modal, traps focus while open, and restores the previously focused element on close.
Accessibility: A visible title provides aria-labelledby; ariaLabel names titleless dialogs, with Dialog as a safety fallback.
Accessibility: Only the top dismissable layer reacts to Escape or outside pointer interaction when dialogs are nested.
Example: <Modal v-model="open" title="Review changes" size="lg" centered>...</Modal>
Example: <Modal v-model="open" aria-label="Confirm publish" :close-on-click-outside="false">...</Modal>

### MonthPicker

Package: `@doctui/dates`

Month selection control that emits YYYY-MM values.

Props: `modelValue`, `year`, `locale`.


### MultiSelect

Package: `@doctui/core`

Searchable multi-value selection control backed by the shared Combobox engine.

Props: `modelValue`, `data`, `id`, `label`, `description`, `error`, `required`, `disabled`, `placeholder`, `clearable`, `ariaLabel`, `nothingFound`, `size`, `radius`.

Accessibility: Uses aria-multiselectable listbox semantics while keeping DOM focus on the native combobox input.
Accessibility: Backspace removes the last selected value when the search query is empty, and controlled updates immediately refresh aria-selected state.
Accessibility: Clear emits an empty array plus the shared clear event.
Example: <MultiSelect id="compare" v-model="frameworks" :data="options" label="Compare with" clearable />

### Notifications

Package: `@doctui/notifications`

Accessible renderer for notifications managed by a store.

Props: `store`, `position`.

Accessibility: Uses a polite live region, status items, and explicit dismiss buttons.

### NumberInput

Package: `@doctui/core`

Native numeric input with numeric v-model values and range constraints.

Props: `modelValue`, `id`, `label`, `description`, `error`, `required`, `size`, `radius`, `disabled`, `readonly`, `placeholder`, `min`, `max`, `step`, `classNames`, `styles`.

Accessibility: Uses a native number input with standard keyboard and validation semantics.
Accessibility: Description, error and consumer-provided aria-describedby IDs are composed instead of replacing one another.
Example: <NumberInput v-model="quantity" label="Quantity" :min="1" :max="10" size="sm" />

### Overlay

Package: `@doctui/core`

Portal-backed semantic-color backdrop with controlled visibility and dismissal.

Props: `modelValue`, `color`, `opacity`, `closeOnClick`.

Accessibility: Backdrop color uses semantic theme tokens and opacity affects only the backdrop, never dialog content.
Accessibility: Overlay is a layering primitive, not a dialog; accessible dialog naming and focus management belong to Modal or Drawer.
Example: <Overlay v-model="open" color="neutral" :opacity="0.55"><div>Surface</div></Overlay>

### Paper

Package: `@doctui/core`

Surface container with optional border, radius and shadow.

Props: `shadow`, `radius`, `withBorder`.


### PasswordInput

Package: `@doctui/core`

Password field built on the shared TextInput contract.

Props: `modelValue`, `id`, `label`, `description`, `error`, `required`, `size`, `radius`, `disabled`, `readonly`, `placeholder`, `clearable`, `classNames`, `styles`.

Accessibility: Uses a native password input and the shared label/help/error relationship contract.
Accessibility: Native form attributes and listeners are forwarded to the password input while class/style customize the outer field root.
Example: <PasswordInput v-model="password" label="Password" autocomplete="current-password" />

### Popover

Package: `@doctui/core`

Dismissable contextual panel anchored to a target slot.

Props: `modelValue`, `position`, `closeOnEscape`, `closeOnClickOutside`.

Accessibility: Provides dialog semantics and consistent outside/Escape dismissal.

### Radio

Package: `@doctui/core`

Native radio option with doctui-controlled visual geometry for a shared scalar v-model.

Props: `modelValue`, `value`, `name`, `id`, `label`, `description`, `error`, `required`, `disabled`, `size`, `classNames`, `styles`.

Accessibility: Uses native radio semantics and keyboard behavior; provide the same name for options in one group.
Accessibility: The custom visual indicator does not replace the native input in the accessibility tree.
Example: <Radio v-model="plan" name="plan" value="pro" label="Pro" size="md" />

### SegmentedControl

Package: `@doctui/core`

Single-selection control with radio semantics and arrow navigation.

Props: `modelValue`, `data`, `ariaLabel`, `size`, `radius`, `disabled`.

Accessibility: Uses radiogroup/radio roles; Arrow, Home, End, Enter and Space are supported.

### Select

Package: `@doctui/core`

Single-value selection control backed by the shared Combobox focus model.

Props: `modelValue`, `data`, `id`, `label`, `description`, `error`, `required`, `disabled`, `placeholder`, `clearable`, `ariaLabel`, `nothingFound`, `size`, `radius`.

Accessibility: Uses the Combobox aria-activedescendant focus model and skips disabled options during keyboard navigation.
Accessibility: Supports a stable public id plus visible-label or ariaLabel accessible naming.
Accessibility: Clear emits both the existing v-model update and the shared clear event.
Example: <Select id="assignee" v-model="assignee" :data="people" label="Assignee" clearable @clear="trackCleared" />

### Skeleton

Package: `@doctui/core`

Loading placeholder that can reveal its content when ready.

Props: `visible`, `height`, `width`, `radius`.

Accessibility: The placeholder is hidden from assistive technology while visible.

### Space

Package: `@doctui/core`

Semantic layout spacer using the theme spacing scale.

Props: `size`, `orientation`.


### Stack

Package: `@doctui/core`

Vertical flex layout for consistent spacing between children.

Props: `as`, `gap`, `align`, `justify`.


### Switch

Package: `@doctui/core`

Boolean toggle that keeps native checkbox behavior behind a doctui track and thumb visual.

Props: `modelValue`, `id`, `label`, `description`, `error`, `required`, `disabled`, `size`, `classNames`, `styles`.

Accessibility: Uses a native checkbox with role=switch and aria-checked while preserving native keyboard and disabled behavior.
Accessibility: Focus-visible styling is rendered on the visual track without hiding the native focus source from assistive technology.
Example: <Switch v-model="notifications" label="Notifications" size="lg" />

### TagsInput

Package: `@doctui/core`

Free-form token field with deterministic parsing, native focus and accessible token-list semantics.

Props: `modelValue`, `id`, `name`, `label`, `description`, `error`, `required`, `disabled`, `readonly`, `placeholder`, `ariaLabel`, `clearable`, `maxTags`, `separator`, `size`, `radius`.

Accessibility: Uses InputWrapper for SSR-safe IDs and field relationships while keeping a native text input as the entry and focus target.
Accessibility: Selected tags are exposed as a list with native remove buttons; Backspace on an empty input removes the last tag without moving focus.
Accessibility: Multi-character separators are parsed from input text, while only one-character separators act as keyboard delimiter keys.
Example: <TagsInput id="skills" name="skills" v-model="skills" label="Skills" :max-tags="5" clearable />
Example: <TagsInput v-model="topics" aria-label="Topics" separator="||" />

### Text

Package: `@doctui/core`

Semantic text primitive using doctui typography and color tokens.

Props: `as`, `size`, `muted`, `weight`.


### Textarea

Package: `@doctui/core`

Multi-line text field with shared input wrapper semantics.

Props: `modelValue`, `id`, `label`, `description`, `error`, `required`, `size`, `radius`, `disabled`, `readonly`, `placeholder`, `rows`, `resize`, `classNames`, `styles`.

Accessibility: Uses a native textarea and links its label, description and error text through accessible IDs.
Accessibility: Read-only fields remain focusable while disabled fields use native disabled semantics.
Example: <Textarea v-model="bio" label="Bio" size="lg" :styles="fieldStyles" />

### TextInput

Package: `@doctui/core`

Single-line text field with shared input wrapper semantics.

Props: `modelValue`, `id`, `label`, `description`, `error`, `required`, `size`, `radius`, `disabled`, `readonly`, `type`, `placeholder`, `leftSection`, `rightSection`, `clearable`, `classNames`, `styles`.

Accessibility: Uses a native input and links its label, description and error text through accessible IDs.
Accessibility: Consumer aria-describedby IDs are composed with doctui-generated message IDs, and error state forces aria-invalid=true.
Example: <TextInput v-model="email" label="Email" autocomplete="email" size="lg" />
Example: <TextInput v-model="query" :class-names="fieldClasses" :styles="fieldStyles" />

### Title

Package: `@doctui/core`

Semantic h1-h6 heading primitive.

Props: `order`.

Accessibility: Heading level is represented by the rendered native h1-h6 element.

### Tooltip

Package: `@doctui/core`

Non-essential contextual text revealed on hover or focus.

Props: `label`, `modelValue`, `position`.

Accessibility: Appears on focus as well as hover and is not intended for critical information.

### UnstyledButton

Package: `@doctui/core`

Native button reset for building custom action surfaces.

Props: `disabled`, `type`.

Accessibility: Preserves native button keyboard and disabled behavior.

### YearPicker

Package: `@doctui/dates`

Year selection control over a configurable range.

Props: `modelValue`, `minYear`, `maxYear`.
